_comment: English body for prompt-case-doc-review. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output a clause checklist; flag only source-supported issues and give no legal conclusion.
Inputs: Document text, review checklist, and scope note.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Review the document against {checklist}. Output items[] with clause, status (present/missing/unclear), quote and risk_note. quote must be verbatim; risk_note describes conditions and consequences only, not legal/illegal conclusions. Mark checklist items absent from the document as missing.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: Clause checklist items[] with status, verbatim quote and risk note.
sections.检查点:
- Quotes link back verbatim.
- Missing items are truly absent.
- Risk notes contain no legal characterisation.
sections.失败分支:
- Paraphrased quote: use verbatim text or mark unclear.
- Checklist too broad: narrow it to this document type.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
